beforeFix.failure: unfinished upload did not close before synthetic fixture guard

checks.name: rejects arbitrary proxy destinations and unknown routes
lists only allowed models and uses server credentials with redirects blocked
server timeout closes unfinished uploads and recovers the occupied concurrency slot
client cancellation of an unfinished upload releases the slot without an upstream call
upstream response timeout aborts the upstream and frees the slot with a safe 504
delivers the first SSE frame over HTTP before upstream EOF
upstream midstream failure terminates the client stream without a false DONE and recovers the slot
deadline cancels a stalled SSE upstream and closes the client stream before releasing the slot
client cancellation of SSE aborts the upstream and restores the slot
rejects a fully uploaded oversized body without using upstream or retaining its slot

network: loopback HTTP only; injected synthetic upstreams
limits: Not a production/FC/TLS/load test; stream failure assertions bounded outside assert.rejects.
